products.product_description: Good Plenty Brand Supreme Abalone Noodles, 21.2 oz. box. Each box contains Retort pouch of Noodles and Abalone. These two pouches are packed together in the box; 10 boxes per case.
products.code_info: Noodle Pack: serial numbers :1-238, expiration date:23/Dec./2017 Abalone Pack: serial numbers : 1-217, expiration date:23/Dec./2017
products.reason_for_recall: During an FDA foreign inspection, it was discovered that Wheat was not properly declared on the product labeling. Wheat is an ingredient in the noodles contained in the product. Wheat is listed in the Contains statement.
